nodes.label: ESP-IDF Build System (project.cmake)
nodes.rationale: ESP-IDF requires cmake_minimum_required, include of project.cmake, and project() in this exact order as boilerplate.

frontmatter.name: advisor
frontmatter.description: Senior embedded/ESP-IDF advisor. Use before non-trivial changes to design the approach (BLE/Bluetooth stack choice, task/queue architecture, memory and power trade-offs, partition/sdkconfig choices) and to produce a concrete implementation plan for the coder.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch

frontmatter.name: coder
frontmatter.description: Implements code changes (ESP-IDF C firmware, CMake, Kconfig, scripts) from a concrete plan handed over by the orchestrator. Use for any task that writes or edits code.

frontmatter.name: extractor
frontmatter.description: Fast, cheap, read-only content extraction. Use to pull specific facts out of files - function signatures, config values, log excerpts, datasheet/doc snippets, sdkconfig options, build output errors - and return them verbatim with file:line references.

frontmatter.name: validator
frontmatter.description: Validates finished changes. Use after the coder reports back - reviews the diff against the plan, builds with idf.py, and reports pass/fail with evidence.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph (graphify-out)
nodes.rationale: Scoped subgraph queries (query/path/explain) return much smaller context than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output; graph kept current via AST-only update with no API cost.
